
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/nijunyang/p/19183269" title="发布于 2025-11-02 20:32">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">k8s-Pod中的网络通信(3)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ue901e845" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">部署的pod都会涉及到和内外网络通信，<span class="ne-text">我们部署的pod 有一个ip，这个IP 是集群内部的IP ，只能在集群内被访问，k8s中pod的网路通信是交给service来管理的，简称svc。负责将外部流量引入，和内部流量引出。</span></span></p>
<h3 id="kvFpC"><span class="ne-text">1.外部流量访问内部</span></h3>
<p id="u6fc9be8f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我们pod部署的时候是有一个标签label的，service在创建的时候也会指定一个标签，这样就可以把对应label的pod关联起来，podIP+端口形成一个端点-ednpoint，service也有自己的IP和端口，service的端口和宿主机的端口通过NodePort形成映射，这样访问宿主机的端口就能访问到service，service再转发到对应的pod上。</span></p>
<p id="ufb538102" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">service的这能力都是kude-proxy来实现的（部署k8s的时候对应的有一个kube-proxy:v1.28.15镜像）。kude-proxy最终会把这这些映射规则转化成iptables规则，来完成流量的转发。</span></p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101113617025-1685582906.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u41a3369e" class="ne-p"><strong>创建service的方式</strong></p>
<p id="u0f125e01" class="ne-p"><strong>命令：expose</strong></p>
<p id="u129719e1" class="ne-p"><strong>清单文件：apply -f 文件</strong></p>
<p id="u5f9ee883" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u48053ccb" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl expose deployment my-nginx-deploment --port=8001 --target-port=80 --type=NodePort</span></code></p>
<p id="ubc6a1a45" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">创建一个service将流量引入到my-nginx-deploment部署的pod上，</span></p>
<p id="u6896c694" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">--port是service暴露的端口，</span></p>
<p id="ucea0d173" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">--target-port是背后实际应用容器的端口，我们部署的nginx是80端口</span></p>
<p id="uaa5bca13" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">--type=NodePort 映射到宿主机端口 取值有这几个 ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, or ExternalName. Default is 'ClusterIP'.</span></p>
<p id="u2d1093e4" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="uf5d830d3" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl expose deployment my-nginx-deploment --port=8001 --target-port=80 --type=NodePort --dry-run=client -o yaml &gt; my-nginx-svc.yaml</span></code></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101135332750-1534128977.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uef85250f" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">apply -f my-nginx-svc.yaml</span></code></p>
<p id="u268211a6" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl get svc</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看service</span></p>
<p id="ud53d9b9c" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl describe svc my-nginx-deploment</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看详细的信息</span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101135644013-486494666.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u947ebb31" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">启了一个service 给svc分配的ip是 10.108.229.67 这个IP 也是集群内部的IP,端口8001，指向了10.244.2.6:80，</span></p>
<p id="uac18e7e2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在集群其他节点可以访问这个地址<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">curl 10.104.212.94:8001</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 也能访问我们之前启动的nginx</span></span></p>
<p id="u4a6542d2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">集群外部访问的话就需要用到NodePort暴露的端口</span></p>
<p id="u2b023a46" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">任意node宿主机节点IP:NodePort暴露的端口</span></p>
<p id="u1c98f7a7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我的是</span></p>
<p id="u11b8fd11" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">192.168.255.102:31101</span></p>
<p id="u5355c875" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">192.168.255.103:31101</span></p>
<p id="u31d8eb9b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">都可以访问到我们部署k8s里面的nginx了</span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101140054977-1241831652.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<h3 id="hkV4e"><span class="ne-text">2.内部访问外部：</span></h3>
<p id="ub542eab2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">pod——service——endpoint——外部服务</span></p>
<p id="ua4f5fb0d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">外部访问内部的时候endpoint 是pod的IP和端口，k8s自己可以知道是啥，内部访问外部的，走出去的时候K8s就不知道关联外部的endpoint了，这就需要手工配置endpoint了</span></p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101141630729-1742220436.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>我在vmware宿主机 IP：192.168.255.1 上面部署一个nginx:</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101151411404-1062864234.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>创建资源清单文件：out-ng.yaml&nbsp; 内容如下</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ng
spec:
  ports:
    </span>- port: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      targetPort: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  # 注意：没有 selector！
</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
apiVersion: v1
kind: Endpoints   # 手动配置的端点
metadata:
  name: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ng       # 必须和 Service 同名！
subsets:
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> addresses:
      </span>- ip: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">   # 外部服务的 IP
    ports:
      </span>- port: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u8a4cbea8" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl apply -f out-ng.yaml&nbsp;</span></code></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101151647110-1562696010.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u1574a076" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">分配给service 的ip是 10.107.74.203 对应端点的是192.168.255.1:80</span></p>
<p id="ubdbf91dd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">进入我们之前的pod里面，再访问service 的ip，就能看到访问到了我们外面机器部署的nginx</span></p>
<p id="udbe2a41b" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl exec my-nginx-deploment-799c59bc4d-nkgbc -it -- /bin/bash</span></code></p>
<p id="u5bec03bb" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">curl 10.107.74.203</span></code></p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101151910343-1489747445.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>我们现在建了两个svc，内部访问外部和外部访问内部是不同的svc负责。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
